title: Kung Pao Chicken with Peanuts and Chilli
summary: A dairy-free Chinese-inspired stir-fry with tender chicken, crunchy peanuts and a glossy chilli-soy sauce. It is quick enough for a weeknight dinner and best served with rice or noodles.

ingredients.name: chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch, the salt and black pepper. Leave to marinate while you prepare the remaining ingredients.
In a small bowl, mix the remaining 2 tbsp soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil and 1 tbsp cornstarch with 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and stir-fry for 5–6 minutes, until browned outside and cooked through.
Add the garlic, ginger, sliced chilli and red bell pepper. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes, until fragrant and the pepper is just tender but still bright.
Pour in the sauce and toss quickly. Cook for 1–2 minutes, until the sauce turns glossy and thick enough to coat the chicken.
Stir in the spring onions and peanuts, cook for 30 seconds to warm through, then remove from the heat and serve immediately.
